### Borea v0.6.0-dev.5: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.6.0 before it is released.
It is not for users.
For normal use, stay on v0.5.2.
It builds on v0.6.0-dev.4, and the list below covers only what changed since that build.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test these first

- Drop-downs, menus, scrolling and text on Windows, Linux and macOS.
  This build updates Avalonia, the UI framework of Borea, so open a few drop-downs and menus, scroll long lists and pages, and read the texts.
  All of them must work and look as on v0.6.0-dev.4.
- The listing editor on a repository whose releases use a tag prefix.
  For example, enter krpc/krpc with the tag prefix ksa-v.
  The editor must find the KSA releases, read their versions and pick the right archive.
- Installs and updates of mods as before.
  Install a mod, update a mod, and remove a mod.
  All of them must work as on v0.6.0-dev.4.
- Going back: after you tested, read "Before you go back to v0.5.2" in the notes of v0.6.0-dev.2, and then start v0.5.2 again.
  Nothing new to know since that build.

#### New since v0.6.0-dev.4

- Borea now carries the .NET 10.0.14 runtime with its security fixes, and Avalonia 12.1.5.
- The listing editor reads the release of a listing with a tag prefix as the index does.
  It keeps only the releases whose tag starts with the prefix, reads the version from the tag after the prefix, and picks the archive by that version.
  Without a prefix, nothing changes.
- When a release offers a smaller archive for the platform of the game, Borea downloads that archive.
  Otherwise Borea downloads the archive for every platform, as before.
  The size shown, the space check and the hash check follow the archive that Borea takes, and a mod installed by hand from any archive of the release is still recognized.
- The messages about the newer KSA part format now have Simplified Chinese texts.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on.
When v0.6.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
